description: Who is behind an IPv4 or IPv6 address: owner and network from the regional registry (RDAP), the ASN, the registry country (not a geolocation), the network type (ISP, mobile, hosting, VPN, Tor, a company's own network) with its confidence and evidence, reverse DNS with a forward-confirmation check (FCrDNS), and matches in public blocklists with their dates. Includes a plain-language verdict and links (only links) to third-party services such as VirusTotal and AbuseIPDB. The full report is at report_url (/ip/<address> on iplover.com).

language.description: Language of the human-readable fields (verdict, explanation, labels).

name: lookup_ip

asn.description: number, name, and the allocation's country and registry (Team Cymru).

country.description: Country in the registry record (code, name, source): where the network is registered, not where the device is.

matched.description: Published lists this address is in.

network.description: Network type: primary, label, status (identified or estimated), confidence and evidence.

owner.description: From the regional registry (RDAP): organization, network, cidr, abuse_email, registry, registered.

owner_failure.description: When the registry did not answer: registry, host, path, HTTP status and reason (rate_limit, 5xx, 4xx, timeout, network, redirect, invalid, budget).

owner_stale.description: When the registry failed just now and owner is the last saved answer for the range: fetched_at (date) and age_days (at most 30). null for a fresh answer.

owner_status.description: ok, not_found, timeout, error or invalid.

pivots.description: Links to check the address elsewhere. iplover does not copy their results.

report_url.description: Public iplover page with the full report for this address: share it, or open it for the explanations and sources.

reverse_dns.description: PTR name and whether it is forward-confirmed (resolves back to this address).

sources.description: Every list checked, with its status and date.

title: Look up an IP address
